description: Authorizes production database changes after validating change approval, migration verification, backup availability, maintenance window, and operational risk.

unboundSignalReasons.changeApproved: Attested by a separate change-management approval step; the Intent carries no approval-status field to bind against.
unboundSignalReasons.migrationValidated: Result of an independent migration-validation check; not a value the Intent itself declares.
unboundSignalReasons.backupAvailable: Result of an independent backup-verification check against operational state; not expressible via the Intent's target/parameters.
unboundSignalReasons.maintenanceWindow: A point-in-time schedule check against the current clock; not a property of the Intent being executed.
unboundSignalReasons.riskScore: A computed operational-risk score, not a value the caller's Intent declares or could be checked against.

outcome.reason: Database change authorized. Change approval, migration validation, backup availability, maintenance window, and operational risk requirements were satisfied.
Database change rejected because the assessed operational risk exceeds the maximum permitted threshold.
Database change rejected because a verified backup is not available.
Database change rejected because execution is outside the approved maintenance window.
Database change rejected because one or more required policy conditions were not satisfied.
